book.name: EFEDZE
book.title: Mukaana a Poole Kundaa basi Efedze

content: Mansweghe ma Kriste
Mu ndagha oyo, me Poole ndi mbwuru a boloko mu esala e Yiisu-Kriste mu nkooro a be, baala ka lili ba-Dzwife o...
Kala ti be líigyughu, bwunu a bu oli esala e bwehe bu Nzaami ki bágwi me mu nkooro a be.
Mu limono baasuo me mansweghe ma Nzaami, ti bwunu a bu aansono me be mo mapfi-mapfi mu mukaana wu.
Bu litaã mukaana wu, be likughu obaghala mayele ma ndi a me mu mansweghe ma Kriste.
Mansweghe mamo ka básuo mo kundaa baana ba baara mu biseene bibike o ti anga bu baasuo mo mu matala ma mu Mufulu kundaa bantumu ba nde baba ngili ya mibighili:
Mu osoolo ti baala ka bali ba-Dzwife o bali a pfa limõ lyini lilo, bali nyuru mõ gyini oyo, bali mu misiini myini mimye, mu Yiisu-Kriste mu nsia yi mbwe.
Mu nkooro a Nsia yi Mbwe oyo me ayi musala, ti bwunu a bu oli ekaba e bwehe bu Nzaami bu baagwi kundaa me, mu nzili a bwehe bu nde.
Kundaa me, me wu mbvulu busala mu mupfunu ŋa kara li baba ngili bwohono, baagwi me bwehe bubo buu otsala kundaa baala ka bali ba-Dzwife o muyighi a busini bu Kriste, ti anga nsia yi mbwe,
ya mu osuo ŋa tse-tse kundaa baara bwohono omoŋono o mansweghe ma Nzaami, nde wu áagyighili bilogho byehene, ábunu mansweghe mamo obaana ku ebaana.
Mpaala mu nzili a libwunu li Nzaami, bamfumu ya ba baakatumu mu mayulu basoolo bunsughu bu Nzaami bubu bifa-bifa,
ti bwunu a bu aagyighili nde, mu Mfumu a bihi Yiisu-Kriste, bitsimi bi ákuru nde mu mibvu ya mibvu.
Mu Yiisu-Kriste, ya mu kana li bihi mu nde, bihi lili a emiini ki ekughu mu obehene ya Nzaami mu kana.
Mu obo me nduomo be mu onyaã otsili bukyini mu nkooro a mpara yi ndi mu okamono me mu be. Mpara oyo yili nsia a be.
Nyaã Kriste akala mu mikolo mi be
Me mu obo me nkunu mabuo ŋa nkulu a Taara.
Me nde aakagwa nkwumu kundaa nswe dzumu li lili ku yulu ya ŋa nsie.
Mpaala mu busini bu nsia a nde, agwa be mpini ya lileene mu Mufulu a nde, mu nkooro a ndaana a mikolo mi be.
Nyaã Kriste akala munsa mikolo mi be mu kana, ya be limyehe midza ya likala ba bágwama mu dzyi,
mpaala emõ ya baba ngili bwohono be lileene obaghala bunene, bula, muyighi, mutele,
ya dzyi li Kriste li liluru ligyahaba lwohono. Mu obo be liilwulu mu busini bu Nzaami bwohono.
Kundaa munde wu kughu ogyighili ku obvulu mi liikaluomo ya mi liikatsimi bihi mu lileene li nde li liikasala mu bihi,
kundaa nde nsia munsa libwunu li Nzaami ya mu Yiisu-Kriste, mu biseene byehene, mu mibvu ya mibvu. Aamene!
